bullets.text: Ukraine's president stated that strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a 'fair response' following 109 Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges, with a Russia-bound ship also attacked in the Gulf of Finland.
A Mexican drug lord, Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores, one of the FBI's 10 most wanted, was arrested after a shootout with authorities, accused of drug trafficking and torture.
A UN report states that one in four women globally are unable to refuse sex within marriage, with almost half of women in west and central Africa lacking this power of consent.
Australia's emergency services will have reduced time to respond to tsunamis originating from the Southern Ocean, as the Macquarie Island seismic station is no longer operational.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's direct challenge to Russian President Vladimir Putin during a recent foreign policy trip has been highlighted as a notable performance, guided by his middle-power ethos.

A 'clean' beauty business in Bondi is under investigation after cigarettes were reportedly served on silver platters at a lip gloss launch, raising concerns from health regulators and the federal government.
US tech stocks, including shares in Anthropic and Nvidia, experienced their worst week since the Covid-19 crisis, plunging into a bear market amid fears over the AI spending boom on Wall Street.
Goldman Sachs and Apollo have priced $32 billion in SpaceX bonds to fund AI chip purchases, addressing a major challenge in financing the high cost of AI chips for corporations.
Former President Donald Trump has threatened a "tremendous" tax on data centers built outside the US, stating the move is crucial to prevent Beijing from taking the lead in AI development.
